## What and why

Describe what this PR changes and the reason for it. Link any related issue
(for example: Closes #123).

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` was run and `dist/terratile.js` is committed (required for
      any change under `src/`)
- [ ] `npm run docs` still generates without errors (for public API changes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Copyright and `NOTICE` attribution are preserved, along with the
      `dist/terratile.js` license banner and the third-party notices
- [ ] Exported APIs documented with JSDoc

## Notes for reviewers

Anything reviewers should focus on, screenshots, or trade-offs.
